codeReview.summary: The unit-conversion code changes in compute.py/solve.py are implemented and well-covered by tests, but the feature did not satisfy its required extraction-eval acceptance criteria.

issues.description: Feature requirements and validation contract require running `uv run python extract.py --test-oracle --n 50` and recording post-change oracle metrics, but baseline_metrics.json still records `n: 20` with no post-change n=50 result. Worker handoff also states the n=50 run timed out and was left undone.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared command definitions conflict with validation criteria for oracle extraction sample size.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/services.yaml:8 defines `oracle_extract` as `uv run python extract.py --test-oracle --n 20`, while validation-contract.md:114 requires `--n 50` for VAL-EXTR-007.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `extract.py --test-oracle` exercises the legacy `extract_answer()` path, not the structured compute/format_result path; this is not documented in shared architecture notes.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: extract.py:1340-1360 calls `extract_answer()` inside `_test_oracle`; .factory/library/architecture.md has no mention of this split; handoff file line 12 explicitly notes this mismatch.

summary: Failing review: implementation quality is good for unit conversion itself, but the feature acceptance requirement to run/report oracle extraction at n=50 was not completed, so VAL-EXTR-007 remains unmet.
